chunks.sanskrit: de̠vasya̍ tvā savi̠tuḥ pra̍sa̠ve̎'śvino̎r bā̠hubhyā̎mpū̠ṣṇo hastā̎bhyā̠māda̠de'bhri̍rasi̠ nāri̍rasi̠ pari̍likhita̠g̠ͫ rakhṣaḥ̠ pari̍likhitā̠ arā̍taya i̠dama̠hagͫ rakhṣa̍so grī̠vā api̍ kṛntāmi̠ yo̎'smān dveṣṭi̠ yañca̍ va̠yandvi̠ṣma i̠dama̍sya grī̠vā api̍ kṛntāmi di̠ve tvā̠'ntari̍khṣāya tvā pṛthi̠vyai tvā̠ śundha̍tālm̐lo̠kaḥ pi̍tṛ̠ṣada̍no̠ yavo̍'si ya̠vayā̠smaddveṣo̍ ya̠vayārā̍tīḥ pitṛ̠ṇāgͫ sada̍nama̠syuddiva̍gͫͫ stabhā̠nā'ntari̍khṣampṛṇa pṛthi̠vīndṛ̍gͫha dyutā̠nastvā̍ māru̠to mi̍notu mi̠trāvaru̍ṇayor dhru̠veṇa̠ dharma̍ṇā brahma̠vani̍ntvā khṣatra̠vani̍gͫ suprajā̠vani̍gͫ rāyaspoṣa̠vani̠mparyū̍hāmi̠ brahma̍ dṛgͫha khṣa̠trandṛ̍gͫha pra̠jāndṛ̍gͫha rā̠yaspoṣa̍ndṛgͫha ghṛ̠tena̍ dyāvāpṛthivī̠ ā pṛ̍ṇethā̠mindra̍sya̠ sado̍'si viśvaja̠nasya̍ chā̠yā pari̍ tvā girvaṇo̠ gira̍ i̠mā bha̍vantu vi̠śvato̍ vṛ̠ddhāyu̠manu̠ vṛddha̍yo̠ juṣṭā̍ bhavantu̠ juṣṭa̍ya̠ indra̍sya̠ syūra̠sīndra̍sya dhru̠vama̍syai̠ndrama̠sīndrā̍ya tvā

ra̠khṣo̠haṇo̍ valaga̠hano̍ vaiṣṇa̠vān kha̍nāmī̠dama̠hantavm̐va̍la̠gamudva̍pāmi̠ yanna̍ssamā̠no yamasa̍māno nica̠khāne̠dame̍na̠madha̍raṅkaromi̠ yo na̍ssamā̠no yo'sa̍māno'rātī̠yati̍ gāya̠treṇa̠ chanda̠sā'va̍bāḍho vala̠gaḥ kimatra̍ bha̠drantannau̍ sa̠ha vi̠rāḍa̍si sapatna̠hā sa̠mrāḍa̍si bhrātṛvya̠hā sva̠rāḍa̍syabhimāti̠hā vi̍śvā̠rāḍa̍si̠ viśvā̍sānnā̠ṣṭrāṇā̍gͫ ha̠ntā

vi̠bhūra̍si pra̠vāha̍ṇo̠ vahni̍rasi havya̠vāha̍naḥ śvā̠tro̍'si̠ prace̍tāstu̠tho̍'si vi̠śvave̍dā u̠śiga̍si ka̠viraṅghā̍rirasi̠ baṃbhā̍rirava̠syura̍si̠ duva̍svāñchu̠ndhyūra̍si mārjā̠līya̍ssa̠mrāḍa̍si kṛ̠śānuḥ̍ pari̠ṣadyo̍'si̠ pava̍mānaḥ pra̠takvā̍'si̠ nabha̍svā̠nasaṃ̍mṛṣṭo'si havya̠sūda̍ ṛ̠tadhā̍mā'si̠ suva̍rjyoti̠r brahma̍jyotirasi̠ suva̍rddhāmā̠'jo̎'syeka̍pā̠dahi̍rasi bu̠ddhniyo̠ raudre̠ṇānī̍kena pā̠hi mā̎'gne pipṛ̠hi mā̠ mā mā̍ higͫsīḥ
tvagͫ so̍ma tanū̠kṛdbhyo̠ dveṣo̎bhyo̠'nyakṛ̍tebhya u̠ru ya̠ntā'si̠ varū̍tha̠g̠ͫͫ svāhā̍ juṣā̠ṇo a̠pturājya̍sya vetu̠ svāhā̠'yanno̍ a̠gnirvari̍vaḥ kṛṇotva̠yammṛdhaḥ̍ pu̠ra e̍tu prabhi̠ndann|
a̠yagͫ śatrū̎ñjayatu̠ jarhṛ̍ṣāṇo̠'yavm̐vāja̍ñjayatu̠ vāja̍sātau|
u̠ru vi̍ṣṇo̠ vi kra̍masvo̠ru khṣayā̍ya naḥ kṛdhi|
ghṛ̠taṅghṛ̍tayone piba̠ prapra̍ ya̠jñapa̍tintira|

somo̍ jigāti gātu̠vid de̠vānā̍meti niṣkṛ̠tamṛ̠tasya̠ yoni̍mā̠sada̠madi̍tyā̠ssado̠'syadi̍tyā̠ssada̠ ā sī̍dai̠ṣa vo̍ deva savita̠ssoma̠stagͫ ra̍khṣaddhva̠mmā vo̍ dabhade̠tattvagͫ so̍ma de̠vo de̠vānupā̍gā i̠dama̠hamma̍nu̠ṣyo̍ manu̠ṣyā̎nthsa̠ha pra̠jayā̍ sa̠ha rā̠yaspoṣe̍ṇa̠ namo̍ de̠vebhya̍ssva̠dhā pi̠tṛbhya̍ i̠dama̠hannirvaru̍ṇasya̠ pāśā̠thsuva̍ra̠bhi vi khye̍ṣavm̐vaiśvāna̠rañjyoti̠ragne̎ vratapate̠ tvavm̐vra̠tānā̎vm̐vra̠tapa̍tirasi̠ yā mama̍ ta̠nūstvayyabhū̍di̠yagͫ sā mayi̠ yā tava̍ ta̠nūr mayyabhū̍de̠ṣā sā tvayi̍ yathāya̠thaṃ nau̎ vratapate vra̠tino̎r vra̠tāni̍

atya̠nyānagā̠nnānyānupā̍gāma̠rvāktvā̠ parai̍ravidampa̠ro'va̍rai̠stantvā̍ juṣe vaiṣṇa̠vande̍vaya̠jyāyai̍ de̠vastvā̍ savi̠tā maddhvā̍'na̠ktvoṣa̍dhe̠ trāya̍svaina̠g̠ͫͫ svadhi̍te̠ maina̍gͫ higͫsī̠r diva̠magre̍ṇa̠ mā le̍khīra̠ntari̍khṣa̠mmaddhye̍na̠ mā hi̍gͫsīḥ pṛthi̠vyā sambha̍va̠ vana̍spate śa̠tava̍lśo̠ vi ro̍ha sa̠hasra̍valśā̠ vi va̠yagͫ ru̍hema̠ yantvā̠'yagͫͫ svadhi̍ti̠steti̍jānaḥ praṇi̠nāya̍ maha̠te saubha̍gā̠yācchi̍nno̠ rāyaḥ̍ su̠vīraḥ̍

pṛ̠thi̠vyai tvā̠ntari̍khṣāya tvā di̠ve tvā̠ śundha̍tālm̐lo̠kaḥ pi̍tṛ̠ṣada̍no̠ yavo̍'si ya̠vayā̠smad dveṣo̍ ya̠vayārā̍tīḥ pitṛ̠ṇāgͫ sada̍namasi svāve̠śo̎'syagre̠gā ne̍tṛ̠ṇāvm̐vana̠spati̠radhi̍ tvā sthāsyati̠ tasya̍ vittād de̠vastvā̍ savi̠tā maddhvā̍'naktu supippa̠lābhya̠stvauṣa̍dhībhya̠ uddiva̍gͫͫ stabhā̠nā'ntari̍khṣampṛṇa pṛthi̠vīmupa̍reṇa dṛgͫha̠ te te̠ dhāmā̎nyuśmasī ga̠maddhye̠ gāvo̠ yatra̠ bhūri̍śṛṅgā a̠yāsaḥ̍|
atrāha̠ tadu̍rugā̠yasya̠ viṣṇoḥ̎ para̠mampa̠damava̍ bhāti̠ bhūreḥ̎||
viṣṇoḥ̠ karmā̍ṇi paśyata̠ yato̎ vra̠tāni̍ paspa̠śe|
indra̍sya̠ yujyaḥ̠ sakhā̎||
tadviṣṇoḥ̎ para̠mampa̠dagͫ sadā̍ paśyanti sū̠rayaḥ̍|
di̠vīva̠ cakhṣu̠rāta̍tam||

bra̠hma̠vani̍ntvā khṣatra̠vani̍gͫ suprajā̠vani̍gͫ rāyaspoṣa̠vani̠mparyū̍hāmi̠ brahma̍ dṛgͫha khṣa̠traṃ dṛ̍gͫha pra̠jāndṛ̍gͫha rā̠yaspoṣa̍ndṛgͫha pari̠vīra̍si̠ pari̍ tvā̠ daivī̠rviśo̎ vyayantā̠mparī̠magͫ rā̠yaspoṣo̠ yaja̍mānammanu̠ṣyā̍ a̠ntari̍khṣasya tvā̠ sānā̠vava̍ gūhāmi

i̠ṣe tvo̍pa̠vīra̠syupo̍ de̠vān daivī̠r viśaḥ̠ prāgu̠r vahnī̍ru̠śijo̠ bṛha̍spate dhā̠rayā̠ vasū̍ni ha̠vyā te̎ svadantā̠ndeva̍ tvaṣṭa̠rvasu̍ raṇva̠ reva̍tī̠ rama̍ddhvama̠gner ja̠nitra̍masi̠ vṛṣa̍ṇau stha u̠rvaśya̍syā̠yura̍si purū̠ravā̍ ghṛ̠tenā̠kte vṛṣa̍ṇandadhāthāṅgāya̠trañchando'nu̠ pra jā̍yasva̠ traiṣṭu̍bha̠ñjāga̍ta̠ñchando'nu̠ pra jā̍yasva̠ bhava̍ta

ā da̍da ṛ̠tasya̍ tvā devahaviḥ̠ pāśe̠nā''ra̍bhe̠ dharṣā̠ mānu̍ṣāna̠dbhyastvauṣa̍dhībhyaḥ̠ prokhṣā̎mya̠pāmpe̠rura̍si svā̠ttañci̠th sade̍vagͫ ha̠vyamāpo̍ devīḥ̠ svada̍taina̠g̠ͫ sante̎ prā̠ṇo vā̠yunā̍ gacchatā̠g̠ͫ saym̐yaja̍trai̠raṅgā̍ni̠ saym̐ya̠jñapa̍tirā̠śiṣā̍ ghṛ̠tenā̠ktau pa̠śuntrā̍yethā̠g̠ͫ reva̍tīr ya̠jñapa̍timpriya̠dhā''* vi̍śa̠toro̍ antarikhṣa sa̠jūr de̠vena̠ vāte̍nā̠sya ha̠viṣaḥ̠ tmanā̍ yaja̠ sama̍sya ta̠nuvā̍ bhava̠ varṣī̍yo̠ varṣī̍yasi ya̠jñe ya̠jñapa̍tindhāḥ pṛ̍thi̠vyāḥ saṃ̠pṛcaḥ̍ pāhi̠ nama̍sta ātānā'na̠rvā prehi̍ ghṛ̠tasya̍ ku̠lyāmanu̍ sa̠ha pra̠jayā̍ sa̠ha rā̠yaspoṣe̠ṇā''po̍ devīḥ śuddhāyuvaḥ śu̠ddhā yū̠yande̠vāgͫ ū̎ḍhvagͫ śu̠ddhā va̠yampari̍viṣṭāḥ parive̠ṣṭāro̍ vo bhūyāsma

vākta̠ ā pyā̍yatāmprā̠ṇasta̠ ā pyā̍yatā̠ñcakhṣu̍sta̠ ā pyā̍yatā̠g̠ͫͫ śrotra̍nta̠ ā pyā̍yatā̠ym̐yā te̎ prā̠ṇāñchugja̠gāma̠ yā cakhṣu̠ryā śrotra̠ym̐yatte̎ krū̠raym̐yadāsthi̍ta̠ntatta̠ ā pyā̍yatā̠ntatta̍ e̠tena̍ śundhatā̠nnābhi̍sta̠ ā pyā̍yatāmpā̠yusta̠ ā pyā̍yatāgͫ śu̠ddhāśca̠ritrāḥ̠ śama̠dbhyaḥ śamoṣa̍dhībhyaḥ̠ śampṛ̍thi̠vyai śamaho̎bhyā̠moṣa̍dhe̠ trāya̍svaina̠g̠ͫͫ svadhi̍te̠ maina̍gͫ higͫsī̠ rakhṣa̍sāmbhā̠go̍'sī̠dama̠hagͫ rakhṣo̍'dha̠mantamo̍ nayāmi̠ yo̎'smān dveṣṭi̠ yañca̍ va̠yandvi̠ṣma i̠dame̍namadha̠mantamo̍ nayāmī̠ṣe tvā̍ ghṛ̠tena̍ dyāvāpṛthivī̠ prorṇvā̍thā̠macchi̍nno̠ rāyaḥ̍ su̠vīra̍ u̠rva̍ntari̍khṣa̠manvi̍hi̠ vāyo̠ vīhi̍ sto̠kānā̠g̠ͫͫ svāho̠rddhvana̍bhasammāru̠taṅga̍cchatam

sante̠ mana̍sā̠ manaḥ̠ samprā̠ṇena̍ prā̠ṇo juṣṭa̍nde̠vebhyo̍ ha̠vyaṅghṛ̠tava̠th svāhai̠ndraḥ prā̠ṇo aṅge̍aṅge̠ ni de̎ddhyadai̠ndro̍'pā̠no aṅge̍aṅge̠ vi bo̍bhuva̠ddeva̍ tvaṣṭa̠rbhūri̍ te̠ sagͫsa̍metu̠ viṣu̍rūpā̠ yath sala̍khṣmāṇo̠ bhava̍tha deva̠trā yanta̠mava̍se̠ sakhā̠yo'nu̍ tvā mā̠tā pi̠taro̍ madantu̠ śrīra̍sya̠gnistvā̎ śrīṇā̠tvāpaḥ̠ sama̍riṇa̠n vāta̍sya tvā̠ dhrajyai̍ pū̠ṣṇo ragͫͫhyā̍ a̠pāmoṣa̍dhīnā̠g̠ͫ rohi̍ṣyai ghṛ̠taṅghṛ̍tapāvānaḥ pibata̠ vasā̎vm̐vasāpāvānaḥ pibatā̠'ntari̍khṣasya ha̠vira̍si̠ svāhā̎ tvā̠'ntari̍khṣāya̠ diśaḥ̍ pra̠diśa̍ ā̠diśo̍ vi̠diśa̍ u̠ddiśaḥ̠ svāhā̍ di̠gbhyo namo̍ di̠gbhyaḥ

sa̠mu̠draṅga̍ccha̠ svāhā̠'ntari̍khṣaṅgaccha̠ svāhā̍ de̠vagͫ sa̍vi̠tāra̍ṅgaccha̠ svāhā̍'horā̠tre ga̍ccha̠ svāhā̍ mi̠trāvaru̍ṇau gaccha̠ svāhā̠ soma̍ṅgaccha̠ svāhā̍ ya̠jñaṅga̍ccha̠ svāhā̠ chandā̍gͫsi gaccha̠ svāhā̠ dyāvā̍pṛthi̠vī ga̍ccha̠ svāhā̠ nabho̍ di̠vyaṅga̍ccha̠ svāhā̠'gnivm̐vai̎śvāna̠raṅga̍ccha̠ svāhā̠'dbhyastvauṣa̍dhībhyo̠ mano̍ me̠ hārdi̍ yaccha ta̠nūntvaca̍mpu̠trannaptā̍ramaśīya̠ śuga̍si̠ tama̠bhi śo̍ca̠ yo̎'smān dveṣṭi̠ yañca̍ va̠yandvi̠ṣmo dhāmno̍dhāmno rājanni̠to va̍ruṇa no muñca̠ yadāpo̠ aghni̍yā̠ varu̠ṇeti̠ śapā̍mahe̠ tato̍ varuṇa no muñca
ha̠viṣma̍tīri̠mā āpo̍ ha̠viṣmā̎n de̠vo a̍ddhva̠ro ha̠viṣmā̠g̠ͫ ā vi̍vāsati ha̠viṣmā̍gͫ astu̠ sūryaḥ̍||
a̠gnervo'pa̍nnagṛhasya̠ sada̍si sādayāmi su̠mnāya̍ sumninīḥ su̠mne mā̍ dhattendrāgni̠yor bhā̍ga̠dheyīḥ̎ stha mi̠trāvaru̍ṇayor bhāga̠dheyīḥ̎ stha̠ viśve̍ṣānde̠vānā̎mbhāga̠dheyīḥ̎ stha ya̠jñe jā̍gṛta

hṛ̠de tvā̠ mana̍se tvā di̠ve tvā̠ sūryā̍ya tvo̠rddhvami̠mama̍ddhva̠raṅkṛ̍dhi di̠vi de̠veṣu̠ hotrā̍ yaccha̠ soma̍ rāja̠nnehyava̍ roha̠ mā bhermā savm̐vi̍kthā̠ mā tvā̍ higͫsiṣampra̠jāstvamu̠pāva̍roha pra̠jāstvāmu̠pāva̍rohantu śṛ̠ṇotva̠gniḥ sa̠midhā̠ hava̍mme śṛ̠ṇvantvāpo̍ dhi̠ṣaṇā̎śca de̠vīḥ|
śṛ̠ṇota̍ grāvāṇo vi̠duṣo̠ nu ya̠jñagͫ śṛ̠ṇotu̍ de̠vaḥ sa̍vi̠tā hava̍mme|

devī̍rāpo apānnapā̠dya ū̠rmirha̍vi̠ṣya̍ indri̠yāvā̎n ma̠dinta̍ma̠stande̠vebhyo̍ deva̠trā dha̍tta śu̠kragͫ śu̍kra̠pebhyo̠ yeṣā̎mbhā̠gaḥ stha svāhā̠ kārṣi̍ra̠syapā̠'pāmmṛ̠ddhragͫ sa̍mu̠drasya̠ vo'khṣi̍tyā̠ unna̍ye|
yama̍gne pṛ̠thsu martya̠māvo̠ vāje̍ṣu̠ yañju̠nāḥ|
sa yantā̠ śaśva̍tī̠riṣaḥ̍
tvama̍gne ru̠dro asu̍ro ma̠ho di̠vastvagͫ śarddho̠ māru̍tampṛ̠khṣa ī̍śiṣe|
tvavm̐vātai̍raru̠ṇairyā̍si śaṃga̠yastvampū̠ṣā vi̍dha̠taḥ pā̍si̠ nutmanā̎||
ā vo̠ rājā̍namaddhva̠rasya̍ ru̠dragͫ hotā̍ragͫ satya̠yaja̠g̠ͫ roda̍syoḥ|
a̠gnimpu̠rā ta̍nayi̠tno ra̠cittā̠ddhira̍ṇyarūpa̠mava̍se kṛṇuddhvam||
a̠gnirhotā̠ niṣa̍sādā̠ yajī̍yānu̠pasthe̍ mā̠tuḥ su̍ra̠bhāvu̍ lo̠ke|
yuvā̍ ka̠viḥ pu̍runi̠ṣṭha ṛ̠tāvā̍ dha̠rtā kṛ̍ṣṭī̠nāmu̠ta maddhya̍ i̠ddhaḥ||
sā̠ddhvīma̍kar de̠vavī̍tinno a̠dya ya̠jñasya̍ ji̠hvāma̍vidāma̠ guhyā̎m|
sa āyu̠rā'gā̎th sura̠bhirvasā̍no bha̠drāma̍kar de̠vahū̍tinno a̠dya||
akra̍ndada̠gniḥ sta̠naya̍nniva̠ dyauḥ khṣāmā̠ reri̍hadvī̠rudhaḥ̍ sama̠ñjann|
sa̠dyo ja̍jñā̠no vi hīmi̠ddho akhya̠dā roda̍sī bhā̠nunā̍ bhātya̠ntaḥ||
tve vasū̍ni purvaṇīka vaso̍ puru̠spṛha̍gͫ ra̠yim||
sa śvi̍tā̠nasta̍nya̠tū ro̍cana̠sthā a̠jare̍bhi̠r nāna̍dadbhi̠ryavi̍ṣṭhaḥ|
yaḥ pā̍va̠kaḥ pu̍ru̠tamaḥ̍ pu̠rūṇi̍ pṛ̠thūnya̠gnira̍nu̠yāti̠ bharva̍nn||
āyu̍ṣṭe vi̠śvato̍ dadhada̠yama̠gnir vare̎ṇyaḥ|
puna̍ste prā̠ṇa ā'ya̍ti̠ parā̠ yakhṣma̍gͫ suvāmi te||
ā̠yu̠rdā a̍gne ha̠viṣo̍ juṣā̠ṇo ghṛ̠tapra̍tīko ghṛ̠tayo̍niredhi|
ghṛ̠tampī̠tvā madhu̠ cāru̠ gavya̍mpi̠teva̍ pu̠trama̠bhi yade̍na̠ndyauraja̍nayath su̠retāḥ̎||
ā yadi̠ṣe nṛ̠pati̠nteja̠ āna̠ṭchuci̠ reto̠ niṣi̍kta̠ndyaura̠bhīke̎|
a̠gniḥ śarddha̍manava̠dyaym̐yuvā̍nagͫͫ svā̠dhiya̍ñjanayath sū̠daya̍cca||
sa tejī̍yasā̠ mana̍sā̠ tvota̍ u̠ta śi̍khṣa svapa̠tyasya̍ śi̠khṣoḥ|
agne̍ rā̠yo nṛta̍masya̠ prabhū̍tau bhū̠yāma̍ te suṣṭu̠taya̍śca̠ vasvaḥ̍||
agne̠ saha̍nta̠mā bha̍ra dyu̠mnasya̍ prā̠sahā̍ ra̠yim|
viśvā̠ ya
